fields.before: Let your little one drift off peacefully with this music mobile. This sweet mobile lets soft sheep, stars, moons and a little cloud gently float above the bed. As the figures slowly turn, they capture your baby’s attention and create a calm, familiar moment before bedtime. The mobile is attached to a wooden cross arm in natural wood, giving it a warm and peaceful look that fits beautifully in the nursery. The sweet figures playfully move above your little one’s head, turning every quiet moment into a little moment of wonder and discovery. Simply wind up the music box and the soothing melody of Schubert’s Lullaby begins to play, while the sweet figures slowly rotate. This creates a relaxed atmosphere that helps your baby unwind. A beautiful addition above the cradle, cot or playpen.
